description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'NumberBase' that provides base functionality for number formatting wizards, including setting decimals, locale validation, and formatting outputs.

classes.name: NumberBase
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for number formatting wizard classes, handling locale and decimal settings.

methods.name: setDecimals
methods.description: Sets the number of decimals, capped at a maximum defined by MAX_DECIMALS.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for number formatting, might throw an exception if the locale code is invalid.

methods.name: getLocaleFormat
methods.description: Abstract method to get locale format, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: validateLocale
methods.description: Validates a locale string against a predefined pattern and formats it into a standard locale string; throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns a general number format string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the object, defaulting to the format method.
